title.suggested: Tom Allen and Other Pugilists Leave for Trial in Lincoln County

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen, Dan Daly, Artie Flint and Tom and Ed Kelly took the train to Troy, Lincoln County, Mo., for trial over the Daly-Kelly fight of two years earlier.

metadata.notes: Masthead on page 2: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Monday, September 16, 1889.

facts.fact: Allen, Dan Daly, Artie Flint, Tom Kelly and Ed Kelly were arrested in St. Louis by Detectives Burke and Fitzgerald at the request of Lincoln County authorities over the Daly-Kelly prize fight
Allen and the others took a Wabash train from Union Depot, St. Louis, to Troy, Lincoln County, Mo., to stand trial, expected that afternoon
Two years earlier the party went to Lincoln County, Mo., for the Dan Daly-Ed Kelly fight, in which Daly won the middleweight championship of Missouri

notes: Arrest was 'about a week ago', so roughly 1889-09-09. Allen is one of five named, so focus suggested secondary. Follows article 775.
